scoring_justification: DFT outputs are large and cannot be recomputed in the verifier; score self-reported values against paper gold with tolerances.

configuration.description: Defect configuration label, e.g. B15N16/C32, B16N16/C31, B15CN16/C31, B16N15C/C31

majority_band_gap_eV.description: Band gap for majority spin in eV

minority_band_gap_eV.description: Band gap for minority spin in eV

spin_polarization_percent.description: Spin polarization at Fermi level P(Ef) in percent

outputs.description: Array of objects for the four defect configurations, each containing the computed total magnetic moment, majority/minority spin band gaps, and spin polarization.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for the four defect configurations (magnetic moments, band gaps, spin polarization, structural conditions).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 (B15N16/C32, B16N16/C31) and Table 3 (B15CN16/C31, B16N15C/C31).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's published tables.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported numbers; no fabrication is needed.

steps.description: Validate that the JSON file is an array of four objects with all required fields and the expected configuration names.
Compare total magnetic moment for each configuration to the paper's value within ±0.2 μB.
Compare majority and minority band gaps for each configuration to the paper's value within ±0.5 eV.
Verify that B15CN16/C31 has spin polarization ≥ 95% (half‑metallic character).

steps.condition: B16N15C/C31 majority_band_gap_eV > 0, minority_band_gap_eV > 0, and majority < minority
steps.description: Verify that B16N15C/C31 is an asymmetric semiconductor with both band gaps positive and majority gap smaller than minority gap.
